criteria.target_business: Manufacturer of industrial valves or other flow-control equipment
criteria.exclusions: pure distributors or resellers; companies owned by private equity firms

html: Kestrel Flow Control develops and manufactures control valves and actuators for water treatment and the food industry.
Kestrel Flow Control was founded in 1998 by two engineers.
Our head office and our plant are located in Kassel, Germany.

label_rationale: Manufactures control valves (industry and target business met). The About page states head office and plant in Kassel, Germany (geography met). No exclusion is indicated.
